changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 4c item 1: extracted resolveConfig (the provider-loading + mergeWithDefaults tail of config.ts's readConfigFile, deliberately excluding plugins[] loading) as an exported function for the upcoming Config Service to reuse on config.agents.replace, and folded loadOrInitConfig's local atomicWriteIfAbsent onto dreamux-utils's existing publishFileExclusive. readConfigFile/loadConfig/loadOrInitConfig keep their exact external behavior and return shapes.
